issues.title: Connect to CouchDb backend
issues.body:
We now have a hosted instance of CouchDb 

I will setup these env vars in the Heroku hosting: `COUCH_ACCOUNT`, `COUCH_PASSWORD`  and `COUCH_URL`

The connection URL will then be `http://` + `COUCH_ACCOUNT` + `:` + `COUCH_PASSWORD` + `@` + `COUCH_URL`

We can then _either_:
1.  create a CouchDb connector to go to that URL
2. tell the local PouchDb to sync to the remote CouchDb URL

Aah, hold on.  I _don't think_ that `_local` documents sync.  Let me investigate.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/161749746-877900e3-6030-4366-915c-36942a37a6b8.png)

Ok, they don't replicate - so they won't sync to/from `couchdb`.  Instead, I _guess_ we could switch to just using id of `settings` instead of `_local/settings`.

Aah, there is one difference:  `_local/settings` doesn't have a history - so new versions always override old-versions.   The wargames can get quite large, so this may be a problem. So, when we save a new `settings` we should update version and ask Pouchdb do delete/archive the old version.
